Oh? 🤨 It seems the English name's recently changed? It's not "Aunn" anymore, but "**Aun**"? — [**HOLY SHIT, IT'S TRUE**](https://www.spriters-resource.com/pc_computer/touhoujuuouenunfinisheddreamofalllivingghost/sheet/206225/).
